question: Primary prophylaxis for Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia (PCP) with co-trimoxazole should be started when the CD4 count falls below 200 cells/μL.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The threshold for PCP primary prophylaxis is CD4 < 200 cells/μL. Remember also that co-trimoxazole is given regardless of CD4 count in WHO Stage 3 or 4 disease.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Co-trimoxazole (trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole) primary prophylaxis for PCP is initiated when CD4 < 200 cells/μL. It is continued until the CD4 count is sustained above 200 cells/μL for at least 3 months on ART.
